note: §1/§2: keyid distinctness is a Kind property — but §2 checks the signature *count* first, so a one-signature Kind can never reach the distinctness check: the same key twice is still two signatures. What is reachable is pinned here; see spec-011-implementation-notes.md §1/§2 for why `duplicate signer` has no reachable case under the contract's stated order.
